prompt: A wide full-bleed painted landscape background for a game screen, filling the entire frame edge to edge. No characters, no people, no animals, no text, no watermark, no border, no frame, no UI. A wide river valley in the clear early morning: the Jordan running shallow and pale green over smooth stones, reed beds and tamarisk along both banks, low ochre hills beyond, a cool pale-gold winter sky with thin mist lifting off the water. A clear walkable path or road runs from the bottom edge of the frame into the distance, centred, with open ground either side — the bottom third must be the walkable foreground, since small character figures are drawn standing on it. Flat stylised storybook painting, clean shapes, soft shading, no photorealism, no line art. Rich but not busy: it sits behind figures and must never compete with them.

THE ENTIRE BACKGROUND MUST BE SOLID PURE MAGENTA, RGB(255,0,255), edge to edge, filling every pixel that is not the figure itself — a flat chroma-key backdrop, NOT white, NOT grey, NOT a coloured wash, NOT a gradient, NOT a vignette, NOT a scene, NOT a border or frame. No ground, no shadow, no horizon, no text, no watermark, no second copy of the figure, no silhouette.

EXACTLY ONE FIGURE, SHOWN FROM THE FRONT IN A SINGLE VIEW. This is NOT a character turnaround, NOT a model sheet, NOT a reference sheet, NOT multiple poses or camera angles side by side, and NOT the same person drawn twice. One person, one pose, one view, alone in the frame.

A FULL-LENGTH STANDING FIGURE, SHOWN HEAD TO FEET, WITH BOTH FEET VISIBLE AND RESTING AT THE BOTTOM EDGE OF THE FRAME. This is NOT a portrait, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders crop, and NOT cropped at the waist, hips or knees — the whole body from the top of the head to the soles of the feet must be inside the frame, standing upright and facing the viewer. Arms at the sides or holding the named object, feet apart and flat.

John the Baptist, a lean weathered man in a rough camel-hair cloak over a short undyed tunic, a wide leather belt at the waist, bare arms, a plain wooden staff in one hand, long dark hair and a beard. Plain and calm, no halo, no weapon.
